title: Sing
targetLabel: A matrix that sings with a drawn face (optional)
intro: Visitors record a song on their phone (up to 10 seconds), pick who sings it and send it. It plays on the show's speakers through EZPlayer while a singing model moves its mouth, a prop glows with the voice, or a matrix shows a singing face. Phones only allow the microphone on a secure page, so visitors use the show's cloud link (https).

fields.text: The singing models of the show (models with a face of the "node range" type with mouths in xLights, read from the show folder)
